notes.title: "Overlook" –
notes.content:
🌟 Discover "Overlook" – A Relaxing Hidden Object Journey!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1780550/OVERLOOK/"][/dynamiclink]
Looking for a cozy, calming adventure full of charm and handcrafted visuals?
Let me introduce Overlook – an upcoming hidden object game where every detail matters and every corner hides a tiny story.

🧩 What makes Overlook special?
Beautiful hand-drawn environments

Lo-fi relaxing soundtrack

50+ quirky characters and hidden items to discover

Environmental storytelling and bite-sized puzzles

Simple and intuitive drag-and-drop gameplay
🎮 A free demo is now available!
Get a taste of the world of Overlook before the full release. Whether you're a fan of indie games, hidden object titles, or just want a peaceful escape, this one is for you.

🗓️ Full release planned for Q3 2025👉 If this looks like your kind of game, please consider adding it to your wishlist![previewyoutube="4i0FKbbMLa4;full"][/previewyoutube]
Your support really helps indie developers and ensures you won’t miss the launch.Let the search begin! 🔍🌿
